source_text: Καταργηθέντων δὲ τῶν τυραννικῶν κολαστηρίων ὑπὸ τοῦ Χριστοῦ διὰ τῆς τῶν μακαρίων ὑπομονῆς, ἑτέρας μηχανὰς ὁ διάβολος ἐπενόει, τὰς κατὰ τὴν εἱρκτὴν ἐν τῷ σκότει καὶ τῷ χαλεπωτάτῳ χωρίῳ συγκλείσεις καὶ τὰς ἐν τῷ ξύλῳ διατάσεις τῶν ποδῶν, ἐπὶ πέμπτον διατεινομένων τρύπημα, καὶ τὰς λοιπὰς αἰκίας, ὅσας εἰώθασιν ὀργιζόμενοι ὑπουργοὶ καὶ ταῦτα διαβόλου πλήρεις διατιθέναι τοὺς ἐγκλειομένους· ὥστε ἀποπνιγῆναι τοὺς πλείστους ἐν τῇ εἱρκτῇ, ὅσους γε ὁ κύριος οὕτως ἐξελθεῖν ἠθέλησεν, ἐπιδεικνὺς τὴν αὐτοῦ δόξαν. Οἱ μὲν γὰρ βασανισθέντες πικρῶς ὥστε δοκεῖν μηδὲ τῆς πάσης θεραπείας τυχόντας ἔτι ζῆσαι δύνασθαι, παρέμενον ἐν τῇ εἱρκτῇ, ἔρημοι μὲν τῆς παρὰ ἀνθρώπων ἐπιμελείας, ἀναρρωννύμενοι δὲ ὑπὸ κυρίου καὶ ἐνδυναμούμενοι καὶ σώματι καὶ ψυχῇ καὶ τοὺς λοιποὺς παρορμῶντες καὶ παραμυθούμενοι· οἱ δὲ νεαροὶ καὶ ἄρτι συνειλημμένοι, ὧν μὴ προκατήχιστο τὰ σώματα, τὸ βάρος οὐκ ἔφερον τῆς συγκλείσεως, ἀλλ᾽ ἔνδον ἐναπέθνησκον.
thought_title: Prison darkness and stocks kill the new prisoners while the tortured survive
orientation: After Biblis confesses and joins the martyrs, the writers describe what the devil devised in prison once the earlier tortures were stopped.
pass_a_gloss: But when the tyrannical tortures had been made inoperative by Christ through the endurance of the blessed ones, the devil devised other contrivances, the confinements in the prison in the darkness and in the harshest place and the stretchings of the feet in the stocks, when stretched to the fifth hole, and the remaining abuses, as many as angry attendants full of devil are accustomed to inflict on those locked up; so that most were suffocated in the prison, as many as the Lord willed to depart in this way, displaying his own glory. For those who had been bitterly tortured so as to seem no longer able to live even if they received all healing care, remained in the prison, abandoned as to care from humans, but being restored by the Lord and being strengthened both in body and in soul and urging on and comforting the rest; but the young ones and those just now arrested, whose bodies had not been hardened beforehand, did not bear the weight of the confinement, but died within.

choices.why: κολαστηρίων is the fixed glossary term and must read torture, and τυραννικῶν marks arbitrary cruelty
μηχανὰς means devised means, keeping the plotting sense after the devil is named as subject

choices.term: τὰς ἐν τῷ ξύλῳ διατάσεις ... ἐπὶ πέμπτον ... τρύπημα
choices.english: stretchings in the stocks ... stretched to the fifth hole
choices.why: ξύλον here is the foot stocks and τρύπημα is the adjustment hole, so the feet are forced apart to the extreme position
αἰκία is distinct from κόλασις and needs a separate ugly literal word for mistreatment inflicted in prison

pass_b_english: Christ had made the tyrannical tortures powerless through the endurance of the blessed. So the devil devised other contrivances: confinement in prison in darkness and in the harshest quarters, the stretching of the feet in the stocks to the fifth hole, and the remaining abuses that enraged jailers, themselves full of the devil, habitually inflict on prisoners. Most were suffocated in prison, all those whom the Lord willed to depart in this way, and He displayed His glory in them.

Those who had been cruelly tortured, so cruelly that it seemed they could not go on living even with every care, remained in prison. They had no human care, yet the Lord restored them and gave them strength in body and soul, and they urged the rest onward and encouraged them. But those who were young and had only just been arrested, whose bodies had not been hardened beforehand, could not bear the weight of confinement and died inside the prison.
